items.headline: Hawkins throws for 464 and Cassidy's FG with no time left lifts West Virginia over Cincinnati 45-42
items.description: — Mike Hawkins Jr. threw for a career-high 464 yards and Jack Cassidy kicked a 35-yard field goal as time ran out to lift West Virginia to a wild 45-42 win over Cincinnati on Saturday.
